title: Bunte Blätter - No. 7
notable_excerpt: Key: E-flat minor. Chord journey: v - repeated vii o6/4#3 vamp in shifting inversions, ii6/5 - iv6 - bVI7 - i6/4 - III - #iii o6/4#2, returns to the repeated vii o6/4 vamp ending on vii o6/4#2. Texture: repeated diminished-seventh chord pulse.
